name: dourmouse-electron
description: Dourmouse native shell (Electron), replacing the pywebview shell in dourmouse/desktop.py. See ~/.claude/plans/sorted-wiggling-pearl.md for the staged migration plan this implements. Stages A-D done (shell/windowing, IPC bridge, tray/notifications/vision helpers, embedded CDP browser pane); Stage E (this file's build/build:mac scripts) packages it as a real macOS .app via electron-builder, replacing build_dist.sh's macOS path.

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: DourMouse's wake-word listener (optional, off by default — DOURMOUSE_WAKEWORD=1) listens locally for its wake word.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: DourMouse's optional in-browser hand-tracking feature (started explicitly by you, per session) uses the camera.
